description: This file defines data structures and functions related to TensorFlow signatures, including the Signature and TensorInfo types, with functions to convert protobuf representations to these types.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: Represents a TensorFlow signature with inputs, outputs, and a method name.

classes.name: TensorInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a TensorFlow tensor, including its name, data type, and shape.

methods.name: signatureDefFromProto
methods.description: Converts a protobuf SignatureDef into a Signature struct.

methods.name: tensorInfoFromProto
methods.description: Converts protobuf TensorInfo into a TensorInfo struct.
